notes: Partition verified: all 22 s### and all 30 t### ids occur exactly once.

s006+s007 → strive is correctly one unit under rule 73: the ASV collapsed ἀγῶνα ἔχω into a single English verb, so rule 2's ordinary split has no second English word to attach to. Source head on ἀγῶνα is right, that being the token strive realizes.

The repeated for's at t014 and t019 are rule 103 function-word helpers on the members they introduce (τῶν and ὅσοι), not added; this matches rule 103's εἰς Μωϋσῆν καὶ τὸν θεόν → against Moses and against God precedent, with t014 riding on the substantival article since that article is itself the coordinate member.
Head of s001 on would rather than have is the verse's open choice and is already named in the unit note; would carries θέλω's volitional sense while have is the causative auxiliary.
